text: Feeling alone? Machiavelli's darkest year... gave the world The Prince.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Fifteen twelve. He loses his job. Then prison. Then a small farm... far from power.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: By day... dust and neighbours. But every evening...
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: he wrote... I pull off my peasant-clothes... and put on my noble court dress.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Then, with the books of great men... for four hours, he forgot every trouble.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The mind's answer. Being alone is an appointment... so dress for it.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rumi's reed flute plays in every crowd... for the happy and the sad.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Yet it sighs... each interprets my notes... but not one fathoms the secrets of my heart.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Lonely... in a full room. And still, that same song moves people to tears.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: My take? Neither man hid it. One wrote it down. One sang it out. Alone isn't the end... it's raw material.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Tonight, one hour alone, phone in another room... and make one thing. A page. A plan. A song.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: When you feel alone... do you reach for the book, or the flute? Tell us below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... you're less alone than you think.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
